About this demo

Independent teaching demo inspired by OpenLab Two-level Transfer Functions. Data: Kitware/vtk.js Head CT. t-SNE uses 5,000 sampled voxels (perplexity 40); the embedding is precomputed and filtered by the I-GM region. Selected points are mapped to other voxels by nearest feature match, restricted to the selected region. This is an approximation, not anatomical segmentation or a reproduction of the original system.
